title: Configuring Query Hints for Optimizing SQL Server Performance

facts.text: Query hints are strategies to override SQL Server execution plans when the query optimizer may make suboptimal choices.
FORCE ORDER hint preserves join order indicated in query syntax and is disabled by default.
LOOP JOIN hint enforces loop join operations for all joins in a query and is disabled by default.
OPTIMIZE FOR UNKNOWN uses statistical data instead of initial values for local variables and parameters and is disabled by default.
Do not change query hint settings from defaults unless certain the change improves your specific scenario.
